settings.repere: Paragraphe · What's the difference between Half Pads
settings.text: What's the difference between Half Pads vs Gel pads?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The difference between the Half Pad vs G
settings.text: The difference between the Half Pad vs Gel pads is - Half pads are breathable because of the mesh fabric. It has anti-chafing and weighs less than gel pad. Gel Pads conform with the shape of the horse and it has cutting edge technology.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Can it go directly on the horse's back?
settings.text: Can it go directly on the horse's back?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We recommend using it on top of a regula
settings.text: We recommend using it on top of a regular saddle pad or a thin sheet / blanket.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Would it work under a western saddle?
settings.text: Would it work under a western saddle?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · While our half pads are primarily design
settings.text: While our half pads are primarily designed for English saddles, several customers have reported positive experiences using them with their Western saddles.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What is the difference between the 3D Ai
settings.text: What is the difference between the 3D Air Mesh and Honeycomb half pads?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · While both pads aim to enhance saddle co
settings.text: While both pads aim to enhance saddle comfort and fit by cushioning the horse's back and distributing pressure evenly to minimize the risk of pressure points, they differ in terms of their materials and unique features.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The 3D Air-Mesh Half Pad offers the bene
settings.text: The 3D Air-Mesh Half Pad offers the benefits of 3D Air-Mesh fabric. This innovative design prioritizes breathability and airflow, ensuring your horse's back stays cool and comfortable during rides.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · On the other hand, we have the Air-Honey
settings.text: On the other hand, we have the Air-Honeycomb Half Pad, which incorporates our exclusive Kavallerie trademark technology called Air Cycle Prene™️. This pad utilizes air-honeycomb material. The Air Cycle Prene™️ technology offers a four-layered cushion with hexagonal-shaped holes (honeycomb design). This unique construction promotes superior airflow and ventilation, effectively dissipating heat from your horse's back. The bottom layer of the pad incorporates Coolmax technology, which effectively wicks away moisture, enhancing evaporation and quick drying.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · In summary, both saddle pads prioritize
settings.text: In summary, both saddle pads prioritize comfort and performance, but they vary in materials and features. The 3D Air-Mesh Half Pad focuses on breathability, while the Air-Honeycomb Half Pad showcases our innovative Air Cycle Prene™️ technology, providing excellent airflow and moisture management.
